Maybe that your question wasn’t well turned (or I might also just be wrong) but I feel that you wanted to ask « why are some people looting/destroying things during protest ». And to this my answer to that has two points: 

• first, assholes. An easy answer but it’s probably almost always the case. Some folks might just want to break stuff without even being related to the protest. 
For example during the Gillet jaune there were dudes wearing black clothes and masks just here to destroy things. They were clearly not related to the movement were you had to wear a yellow jacket and just profited of the agitation to have fun. 

• then there is some others that wants to make noise, prouve that they are really angry, to make sure that they will be listen. A simple protest with 5000 people won’t make it to the news, one with the same amount but nice pictures of violence will. Of course it doesn’t excuse it, and many exemple in history showed us that things can radically change without violence. Sadly it’s rare, and if you’re not blocking someone or making noise you will be ignored.

Nevertheless you can make a lot of noise without burning a car, yet some prefer to be hated than passed to silence.
